text:
Evan (CSM): Morning team — planning our customer engagement for Rivermark ahead of Friday's exec readout. Need slide owners, onboarding health snapshot, renewal signal, and enablement asks. Deck link: https://redwood.app/decks/rivermark-qbr :link:

Priya (AM): I can own onboarding health + adoption metrics. Will pull last 30 days usage and doc open rates. ETA Thu 3pm. :white_check_mark:

Oliver - Sales: I'll handle the renewal signal + exec ask slide. High-level: renewal in 60 days, upsell opportunity on Dedicated. Need clarified ARR and current spend. @Priya can you confirm committed seats?

Priya (AM): They are at 18 seats, on 12-month commit. Current MRR trending +4% MoM but token spend spiked last week (we're investigating).

Samir Eng: For the enablement slide I can add 2 tech blockers we fixed and runbook for integration. Quick question — do we want to include sample prompt templates?

Ava PM: Yes include 1-2 templates and one known failure case + mitigation (to show we monitor quality). Also call out expected latency improvements after the runtime patch next week.

Evan (CSM): Great. Action list so far:
- Priya: onboarding health + usage chart (Thu 3pm)
- Oliver: renewal signal + executive ask (Thu 5pm)
- Samir: enablement/runbook + templates (Thu EOD)
- Ava: failure case + perf note (Thu EOD)
Please add slide file names in the deck and tag reviewers.

Priya (AM): Putting my slide at deck > slides/2-onboarding-health.png and adding notes. Also filing short bullets for adoption blockers.

deck-bot: Deck updated by Priya (AM): https://redwood.app/decks/rivermark-qbr#slide=2

Oliver - Sales: FYI — I flagged the potential upsell as "Dedicated trial" and added expected revenue uplift numbers. Need Evan to confirm risk tolerance for a canary offer.

Evan (CSM): I'm okay with a limited canary (4–6 weeks max). Add fallback: if latency >150ms on p95, revert to hosted baseline. Samir, can you add that as an ops guardrail?

Samir Eng: Yep — will add guardrail and alert rule snippet. Pasting quick config to include:

```yaml
alert: RivermarkLatencyGuard
expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le)) > 0.15
for: 2m
labels:
  severity: high
annotations:
  summary: "Rivermark p95 latency > 150ms"
```

Ava PM: Also recommend we run a short enablement webinar for Rivermark's platform team next Tue. Add as a follow-up action in the slide.

Evan (CSM): Noted. New action: schedule 30m enablement webinar (Ava + Samir) — target Tue next week.

Priya (AM): Renewal risk flags: they mentioned budget review in 6 weeks and a competing vendor POC. I've added a sidebar slide on churn signals and recommended mitigation steps (exec intro, usage incentives).

Oliver - Sales: Can you add top 3 customer execs we should brief? I have names, will drop in the slide notes.

Priya (AM): Dropped exec contacts in notes: Claire (CTO), Jonah (Head of Data), Mari (Procurement).

deck-bot: Reminder: presentation deadline for design review is Thu 6pm PST.

Evan (CSM): Two quick asks before we wrap: 1) Can everyone add one concrete ask for the execs (e.g., approval for pilot, budget endorsement)? 2) Please annotate any numbers with source (analytics, contract).

Samir Eng: Added ask: "Approve Dedicated pilot for 6 weeks with rollback guardrails" in slide 6. Sources: infra logs + token billing report (link in notes).

Ava PM: Added ask: "Enable a practitioner workshop to reduce integration time by 30%" and linked the playbook.

Oliver - Sales: Added ask: "Commit to 6-month uplift if pilot meets SLA" and annotated expected ARR uplift.

Evan (CSM): Perfect. Final pre-read checklist:
- [ ] Slides uploaded and named correctly
- [ ] Numbers sourced and linked
- [ ] One-line exec asks per slide
- [ ] Risks + mitigation slide included
- [ ] Enablement webinar scheduled

Priya (AM): I'll run the pre-read pass at Thu 5:30 and call out any gaps.

Evan (CSM): Thanks team. If anything blocks, DM me. Will post final link and run brief dry run Thu 7pm PST. :rocket:
